text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Yasuda Kinen. "IRON WILL" 
assessed that Yamanin Zephyr's rate of 
growth was astounding.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wasn't the only one. Among the active 
Umamusume, more and more were influencing 
each other and growing far beyond all 
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus rejoiced at this turn of 
events. A world where every Umamusume can 
continue running for as long as they 
desire—that was her ultimate goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She says it's because for such an 
ambitious goal, the more positive, 
unpredictable factors there are, the 
higher the chances of making it a reality.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Along that path, Yamanin Zephyr is an 
opponent who must be overcome. The stormy 
Yasuda Kinen begins!
